comment: Menu item Low cpu mode sets AdvancedSampler::low_cpu_ and nothing reads it: grep finds the member only at its declaration and in the menu item's onAction and step. It is also absent from dataToJson, so it is not even remembered. Menu item Trim sample is defective. AudioClip::trim computes samples_to_copy = (end - start) * n and remove_l = start * n, then copies with `for (int i = remove_l; i < samples_to_copy; i++)`, which stops at samples_to_copy rather than remove_l + samples_to_copy; the second loop then pushes samples_to_copy values back out of a vector holding only samples_to_copy - remove_l of them, reading past its end. Trimming from a start of 0 is the only safe case. A fourth light, REC_LIGHT_BLUE, is declared in the LightIds enum, is never set in process() and has no LightWidget on the panel. process() calls light_timer_.process(args.sampleTime) twice per sample, once on its own line and once inside the comparison, so the lamp refresh runs at twice the intended rate; this is cosmetic. The recording limit is a fixed sample count, maxRecordSamples = 44100 * 10, not a fixed duration, so it shortens as the engine rate rises. Envelope times come from the baked env_time_ table in src/dsp/LutEnvelope.hpp, which runs from an increment of 1000 per second at the left through 1 at the centre to 0 at the right; setMinMaxTime is never called, so the table is used as written and the far right of either knob is a stage that never completes.
